hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *.nika.yaml) RESULT=$(nika check "$FILE" 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "NIKA VALIDATION FAILED for $FILE:" >&2; echo "$RESULT" >&2; echo '' >&2; echo 'Fix the issues above before continuing.' >&2; exit 2; else echo "Nika: $FILE validated successfully"; fi;; esac; exit 0

PLUGIN_DIR="$(dirname "$0" 2>/dev/null || echo .)/../.claude-plugin"; NIKA_VERSION=$(nika --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'not installed'); YAML_COUNT=$(find . -name '*.nika.yaml' -maxdepth 5 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); NIKA_DIR=''; [ -d '.nika' ] && NIKA_DIR='found' || NIKA_DIR='not found'; echo "Nika plugin active | $NIKA_VERSION | $YAML_COUNT workflow(s) detected | .nika dir: $NIKA_DIR"; if [ "$YAML_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then echo 'Tip: Use /nika-wizard to create new workflows, /nika-doctor to diagnose issues'; fi

MODIFIED=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep '\.nika\.yaml$' || true); STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep '\.nika\.yaml$' || true); ALL="$MODIFIED $STAGED"; ALL=$(echo "$ALL" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -u | grep -v '^$'); if [ -n "$ALL" ]; then ERRORS=0; for f in $ALL; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then RESULT=$(nika check "$f" 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "VALIDATION FAILED: $f" >&2; echo "$RESULT" >&2; echo '' >&2; ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1)); fi; fi; done; if [ $ERRORS -gt 0 ]; then echo "$ERRORS workflow file(s) have validation errors. Fix before committing." >&2; exit 2; else echo "All modified .nika.yaml files validated successfully."; fi; fi; exit 0
